rows.label: tlk47300163_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Doesn't matter how much we
clear up these pests, they're
back before you know it.

rows.label: tlk47300163_04_msg0003
rows.name:
So I've been thinking about
cooking up some special pesticide
to protect the fields with.

rows.label: tlk47300163_04_msg0004
rows.name:
But getting hold of the
ingredients is a bit tricky...

rows.label: tlk47300163_04_msg0005
rows.name:
I'd need some Ururaa Grady ooze and
some fruit...

rows.label: tlk47300163_04_msg0006
rows.name:
I can sort the fruit, no problem. It's
that Ururaa Grady ooze that's the
tricky thing...

rows.label: tlk47300163_04_msg0007
rows.name:
Was thinking about getting
some mercs in on the job...

rows.label: tlk47300163_04_msg0008
rows.name:
Oh! You'll get it for me?
That would be a huge help!

rows.label: tlk47300163_04_msg0009
rows.name: Just what I need for the pesticide!
